text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0850 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne higher on bullishly construed StatsCan acreage report pegging area at 12.1 million acres, the low end of trade expectations. Gains should be limited by lower CBOT soybean calls. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +1.67 Thursday from +0.96 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3810 to the U.S. dollar, rose to 82.69 yen, rose to 1.2534 marks.
FLAXSEED - Mixed. C$1.00 up on StatsCan's acreage estimate of 2.07 million acres below trade expectations.
C$1.00 down on expected follow through selling from Thursday's trade.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on CBOT corn calls. July liquidation was expected to be the feature.

The Canadian Wheat Board's unchanged Pool Return Outlook world price forecast Thursday was seen neutral while StatsCan's estimate of 12.4 million acres was seen slightly bullish for new crop but old crop carryout may mute gains.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls and follow through selling from Thursday's trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
